Title: We’re Asking an Appeals Court to Require a Warrant for ALPR Searches
Description: Automated license plate readers are simply not comparable to observing an individual license plate on a passing car. As we’ve explained in many amicus briefs and in our lawsuits directly challenging their use, ALPRs give law enforcement “a virtual time machine to view suspects’, or anyone else’s, past movements (and much more) with just the click of a button.”

Title: Ops needs friction
Description:
Between Microsoft's two-day outage and the FAA ground stop yesterday, there's plenty of ink spilled about who's responsible, why these things happened, etc.
But it made me think back to some of the infrastructure and ops teams I've worked on, and similar (though much smaller scale) outages we encountered.
Having an ops mindset is fundamentally different from a development or project management mindset. And it took me over a decade of software development to understand why.
